title: Binary output for an exponential value
statement: For all natural numbers $C$ and $c$, there exist a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and a natural number $A$ such that, on every Boolean word $x$, $M$ outputs the list of binary digits of $C\,2^{(\operatorname{length}(x)+1)^c}$ within $A(\operatorname{length}(x)+1)^{c+1}$ steps.
replaced:
For all constants $C, c$ there exist a finite machine and a constant $A$ such
that the machine computes, from each input $x$, the binary-digit list of
$C \cdot 2^{(|x|+1)^c}$ within time $A (|x| + 1)^{c+1}$.
